fluff.overview: The Combine's martial traditions extend beyond the BattleMech cockpit, and the Dictum Honorium demands that all citizens contribute their talents to the defense of House Kurita. Infantry soldiers of the DCMS embody that expectation on garrison worlds across the realm. Tracked mechanized infantry ride armored carriers that can cross rough ground where wheeled vehicles cannot follow. The DCMS values these platoons for operations on worlds with poor road infrastructure, where the broken terrain that stops lighter transport is simply another day's march for tracked APCs and the soldiers they carry. Their support troops carry man-portable flamers that spray burning chemicals across several hundred square meters. Devastating against infantry in the open and effective at clearing structures, though the short range and the vulnerability of the operator's fuel tank make flamer duty one of the most dangerous assignments in the platoon.
